description.value:
Every child is filled with stories of them; the mere mention of their name is enough to invoke fright as if they crept in wait, ready to snatch them if they were misbehaving. Hobgoblins come to steal you in the night. Bauchan corrupt and ruin the trees. The Servants of Devils turning you to blasphemy. Bloodthirsty fiends intent on rending children limb from limb. Blood drinkers, leaving your corpse to dry. The list goes on. In the times since, they’ve become known, but suspicion and trust are always a coin toss away. The memory of grisly drawings of misshapen flesh and horns during war; the old tales of violent rituals and sacrificed prisoners; the sight of ferocity and rage as blood rained. There is a story behind the legends, but their truths are scattered and its roots are secluded in the most dangerous lands known to man – the Isle of Zaho.
